messages.subject: Hierarchical Lincoln-Petersen model: epilogue
parts:
Dear all,

after all here is a fitting model for my problem (hopefully this code will be useful to someone). I used an overdispersed poisson distribution. As John pointed out, given the very large variability and low number of replicates I was unlikely to find any significant effect of the treatments on snail population size. And this is indeed the case. However, I have learnt a lot and am more than ever happy with using JAGS and hierarchical models. Thank you all for your help!

éric

cat(file = "Lincoln_petersen_poisson.jags", "
model{
##### PRIORS AND CONSTRAINTS
# abundance model
  for(i in 1:M){
        g[i] ~ dcat(gprobs[])
        z[i] ~ dbern(psi)
    }
  psi <- sum(lam[])/M
  for(j in 1:tr){
    beta[j] ~ dnorm(0, 0.1)
    }
  tau.lam <- pow(sd.lam, -2)
  sd.lam ~ dunif(0, 10)   
# detection model
  for(i in 1:M){
        treat.long[i] ~ dcat(tprobs[])
    }
for(j in 1:tr){
    gamma[j] ~ dnorm(0, 0.1)
    tprobs[j] ~ dunif(0,1)
        }
##### LIKELIHOOD
# abundance model
  for(s in 1:S){
    gprobs[s] <- lam[s]/sum(lam[])
        log(lam[s]) <- beta[treat[s]] + eps[s]
        eps[s] ~ dnorm(0, tau.lam)
    }
# detection model
  for(i in 1:M){
        y[i] ~ dbin(mu[i], K)
       mu[i] <- z[i]*p[i]
    p[i] <- exp(lp[i])/(1+exp(lp[i]))
       lp[i] <- gamma[treat.long[i]]
    }
##### GOODNESS OF FIT
  for(s in 1:S){
        Eobs[s] <- pow(tobs[s] - sum(tobs[])*gprobs[s], 2) / (sum(tobs[])*gprobs[s])
        Esim[s] <- pow(lam[s]*cprob[s] - sum(lam[])*gprobs[s], 2) / (sum(lam[])*gprobs[s])   
  }    

#### DERIVED QUANTITIES
cprob[1] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[1]))
cprob[5] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[1]))
cprob[9] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[1]))
cprob[2] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[2]))
cprob[6] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[2]))
cprob[10] <- 1/(1+exp(-gamma[2]))
cprob[3] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[3]))
cprob[7] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[3]))
cprob[11] <- 1/(1+exp(-gamma[3]))
cprob[4] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[4]))
cprob[8] <-  1/(1+exp(-gamma[4]))
cprob[12] <- 1/(1+exp(-gamma[4]))
fit <- sum(Eobs[])
fit.new <- sum(Esim[])
}
")
